description:
Amazon WorkSpaces plays nice with everyone. Access your personal Windows environment on Android, iOS, Fire, Mac, PC, Chromebook, and Linux devices.


- [Windows] The new client experience is now the default. You can still switch to the classic experience, and your choice is remembered. Administrators may continue to require the classic experience.
- [Windows] PCoIP-based WorkSpaces and WorkSpaces Pools now open in the classic experience automatically when started from the new client experience, without needing you to sign in again.
- [Windows] Added the WorkSpaces Advisor (preview) to the new client experience. It checks your device, network, and the WorkSpaces service, and recommends resolution steps when registration, sign-in, or connecting encounter issues, or when your session disconnects.
- [Windows] Added a welcome tour to the new client experience, shown on first launch and in your first session. You can replay them any time from the Help menu.
- [Windows] WorkSpace registration codes now stay in sync between the classic and new client experiences.
- [Windows] Your display language choice now carries over in both directions between the classic and new client experiences.
- [Windows] Added a self-service option to enable nested virtualization for supported WorkSpaces in the new client experience.
- [Windows] Added the ability to choose the microphone and speaker used for your session in the new client experience.
- [Windows] The new client experience now opens on the display where you last used it. If that display isn't connected, it opens on the display you launched it from.
- [Windows] Added relative mouse mode, which uses relative coordinates and is useful for graphics applications such as computer-aided design (CAD) or video games, to the new client experience.
- [Windows] Added support for redirecting mailto and ftp links from your WorkSpace to your local device in the new client experience.
- [Windows] Added support for command-line sign-in in the new client experience.
- [Windows] Added a short, optional satisfaction survey that may appear occasionally in the new client experience, after disconnecting from your session.
- [Windows] The new client experience now uses the proxy configured in Settings for streaming over TCP and for the Advisor's network checks.
- [Windows] When you first open this client, your network settings are carried over from the experience you used last, ensuring connectivity in the new client.
- [Windows] Refreshed the visual design of the new client experience, and updated the app icon for both experiences and the installer.
- [Windows] The installer now shows you any existing copies of the client and what will happen to each, and upgrades only the copy in the installation scope you choose.
- [Windows] Documentation and other external links in the new client experience now open China-specific sites in the AWS China (Ningxia) Region.
- [Windows] Self-service dialogs in the new client experience now default to Cancel, so pressing Enter no longer starts the action, and screen readers read their options by name.
- [Windows] Fixed an issue in the new client experience that prevented signing in with certificate-based authentication to a WorkSpace that doesn't support it. You are now asked to sign in with your password instead, as in the classic experience.
- [Windows] Fixed an issue in the new client experience that caused some screens to not follow Windows contrast themes.
- [Windows] Fixed an issue in the new client experience that caused screen readers to not read in-session notifications.
- [Windows] Fixed an issue in the new client experience that caused a Windows location prompt to appear under certain conditions.
- [Windows] Fixed an issue in the new client experience that could prevent automatic updates from starting for single user installations.
- [Windows] Updated the DCV SDK.
- [Windows] Additional bug fixes and enhancements.
